images.title: Small squares that join
images.purpose: Show that 3 pieces of 1/24 shade the same area as 1/8 of the grid, and 2 pieces of 1/24 the same area as 1/12.
images.composition: Two copies of the same 6 by 4 grid: on the left 3 squares shaded in a group of 3, on the right 2 squares shaded in a group of 2, each with its two names written below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top, centred at x 728 and y 80, the heading Each square is 1/24 of the grid in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (48 px). Two identical grids stand side by side. Each grid is 6 columns by 4 rows of equal squares, every square 80 by 80 px, so each grid is 480 px wide and 320 px tall and has 24 squares; thin dark #2B2B2B grid lines (2 px) and a 3 px outer outline. LEFT GRID: x 168 to 648, y 170 to 490. Thick dark lines (6 px): one vertical line full height between column 3 and column 4 (x 408), and 3 horizontal lines full width between the 4 rows. So the grid is cut into 8 equal groups of 3 squares (2 groups in each row). The first group, the 3 squares at the left of the top row (x 168 to 408, y 170 to 250), is filled teal #0072B2; the other 21 squares are white. RIGHT GRID: x 808 to 1288, y 170 to 490. Thick dark lines (6 px): 2 vertical lines full height between column 2 and column 3 (x 968) and between column 4 and column 5 (x 1128), and 3 horizontal lines full width between the 4 rows. So the grid is cut into 12 equal groups of 2 squares (3 groups in each row). The first group, the 2 squares at the left of the top row (x 808 to 968, y 170 to 250), is filled amber #E69F00; the other 22 squares are white. Under the left grid, centred at x 408: 3/24 = 1/8 at y 570 (64 px bold) and 3 squares at y 630 (36 px). Under the right grid, centred at x 1048: 2/24 = 1/12 at y 570 (64 px bold) and 2 squares at y 630 (36 px). No other text, no numbers inside the squares. Nothing else in the frame.
labels: Each square is 1/24 of the grid
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a grid with a row or column count other than 6 columns and 4 rows, or a shaded group of any size other than 3 squares on the left and 2 on the right
images.takeaway: Small equal parts can join to cover the same area as a bigger fraction: 3/24 = 1/8 and 2/24 = 1/12.
images.description: Two grids of 6 columns by 4 rows: 3 squares are shaded and named 3/24 = 1/8 on the left, and 2 squares are shaded and named 2/24 = 1/12 on the right.
images.context: Concept image for Small Parts That Join. It follows the idea of the figure in your maths book (single squares joined to match a bigger fraction of the grid) and uses the numbers of this concept's own example: 24 squares, 1/8 and 1/12.
images.teaching_notes: Shade the squares one at a time and count them until the shaded group matches one group of the cut. The slip to watch: thinking 3/24 is a different amount from 1/8 because the numbers look different.

image_decisions.why: The shaded squares and the thick group lines make it visible that 3 small squares and one group of 1/8 cover the same area.
